source.from: EmailSum (Zhang et al., 2021): multi-mail threads whose later mails change earlier facts; structure only

request: Summarize the thread about Tom's thesis committee meeting.

mails.subject: Thesis committee for Tom Okafor
mails.body:
Daniel,

Shall we hold Tom's thesis committee meeting on Thursday 3 December at 10:00 in room B110?

Sofia

mails.subject: Re: Thesis committee for Tom Okafor
mails.body:
Sofia,

3 December works for me. Tom, please send your progress report one week before the meeting.

Daniel

mails.subject: Re: Thesis committee for Tom Okafor
mails.body:
Dear Professor Whitmore, dear Dr. Lindqvist,

I am at a conference on 3 December. Could we move the meeting to Thursday 10 December?

Best regards,
Tom

mails.subject: Re: Thesis committee for Tom Okafor
mails.body:
Fine with me: Thursday 10 December at 14:00. Room B110 is taken that afternoon, so we will meet in room A205. The external examiner, Prof. Ines Duarte, will join by video.

Sofia

mails.subject: Re: Thesis committee for Tom Okafor
mails.body:
Thank you both. I will send my progress report by Thursday 3 December.

Tom
